description: This source file defines the ShippingProduct class, which models a product with an associated quantity in a shipping context within the sales management system.

classes.name: ShippingProduct
classes.description: A class representing a product included in shipping, with an associated quantity and a reference to a Product model.

methods.name: ShippingProduct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ShippingProduct instance with a specified Product.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product for shipping.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product for shipping.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the Product associated with this ShippingProduct.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the Product associated with this ShippingProduct.
